newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine exports rise in March.
newsitem.headline: Philippine exports rise in March.

text.p: Philippine exports in March rose to $1.996 billion from $1.67 billion a year ago, the National Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
Exports for the first three months of the year were also higher at $5.50 billion against $4.69 billion a year earlier.

The statistics office said exports in March were led by electronics and components which rose 30.8 percent to $861 million in March. Electronic exports accounted for 43 percent of overseas sales in March.

Garments, the second biggest earner with a share of 9.7 percent of the total, recorded sales of $193 million in March, down 1.4 percent. Garment exports have suffered from more competitiion from other countries, government officials said.
The U.S. and Japan continued to be the country's biggest markets with a share of 34 and 17 percent respectively of the total merchandise exports for March.
